summary: Iteration 3 — validated NEW safety / trial-readiness features. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (visible_for=15 -> visibility_expires_at ~15min ahead; quiet_mode + trial_mode_active persist; POST /api/pings/generate returns {ping:null} while quiet_mode=true; GET /api/nearby returns verified+active_now fields with James/Olivia/Mia/Sophie/Ryan=verified and Sarah/Jake/Liam/Emily=unverified; GET /api/trial returns Southbank Social Trial (64 active users) + active flag; POST /api/feedback increments conversations_confirmed; POST /api/analytics {profile_view} increments profile_views; GET /api/metrics returns exactly the 11 counters as int; POST /api/blocks ends any active meetup with the blocked user — verified via throwaway registered user meeting a demo, then blocking, GET /api/meetups/active -> null). Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): Welcome -> Get Started -> how-location-screen -> location-understand -> Register screen works; demo-login as Kauri shows Radar 'Approximate distance only. Exact location stays hidden.' note + Nearby Now 'About 25m away' Sarah label; best-view-profile opens person profile with active-now-badge + safety-protected-badge + person-block + person-report + person-connect present; person-report -> /report screen has 5-of-6 expected reason labels + report-details textarea + report-submit works; Profile menu has menu-trial + menu-invite + menu-metrics; Trial screen renders with 64 active users + trial-join button, joining sets user.trial_mode_active and radar shows trial-banner; Metrics screen matches 9/11 metric label keywords; Invite screen has invite-copy; Privacy has toggle-quiet + save-privacy; Radar radius=10 shows radar-empty + empty-increase-radius/empty-invite/empty-change-vibe (all 3 CTAs); visibility-session-chip 'Visible · 60m left' visible on radar after visible=true+visible_for save. State restored at end (Kauri: radius 50, visible true, vibe networking, quiet_mode false, trial_mode_active false).

context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (10 cases) covers iteration_3 features; the old /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from iteration_2 still passes. Ping-modal continues to overlap bottom of Radar in Expo Web preview — dismiss it before tapping best-view-profile / tab-bar. Trial event stats are hard-coded in server.py (TRIAL_EVENT dict); the only dynamic bit is user.trial_mode_active. `visibility_expires_at` is refreshed every time PUT /api/users/me/state is called with visible=true OR visible_for present, so any subsequent state update effectively re-arms the visibility session — noted for future tests.
